events.title: Intrepid Potash (IPI) Q1 Earnings Surpass Estimates
events.body: Intrepid Potash (IPI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +29.17% and -6.03%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Aura Minerals Gears Up to Report Q1 Earnings: How to Play the Stock?
events.body: AUGO heads into Q1 earnings with surging output and a 443% EPS growth outlook as mine ramp-ups and expansions drive record production.

events.title: Why NexGen Energy (TSX:NXE) Is Up 5.9% After Final Federal Approval For Rook I Project
events.body: NexGen Energy has received final federal approval for its Rook I uranium project, clearing a major regulatory hurdle and allowing construction to proceed as planned from summer 2026. This approval meaningfully reduces regulatory uncertainty
